title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there, and she'll dig in.

items.headline_md: US envoys **Witkoff** and **Kushner** arrive in Moscow to meet **Putin**
items.summary_md: It follows Abu Dhabi talks where Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle on a new large-scale prisoner exchange.

items.headline_md: Israel's security cabinet orders the military to prepare for a possible strike on **Iran**
items.summary_md: Iran warned that US bases and interests are within range of its missiles and drones.

items.headline_md: Iran refuses to hand over its enriched uranium as two more tankers explode in **Hormuz**
items.summary_md: Security chief Mohsen Rezaei said no talks with Washington are under way; the Revolutionary Guards reported the tanker blasts.

items.headline_md: Democrat **Scott Colom** wins Mississippi's Senate race
items.summary_md: He's the state's first Democratic senator in nearly four decades and its first Black US senator since Reconstruction.

items.headline_md: Spain holds its first general strike in **14 years** over housing costs
items.summary_md: Millions joined; separately, Congo's Ebola outbreak has passed **11,000** cases and **5,000** deaths, the deadliest in its history.

items.headline_md: **Nvidia**'s board is preparing to oust CEO **Jensen Huang**, WSJ reports
items.summary_md: The move follows a company probe into an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, plus a reported second affair with an Nvidia executive.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI**'s quarterly revenue reportedly tops **$10 billion**, but heavy losses continue
items.summary_md: Its adjusted operating margin improved but it remains far from profitable.

items.headline_md: **Pfizer** signs a **$1.5 billion** deal with **Blackstone** to fund a weight-loss drug
items.summary_md: The money covers development of berobenatide, an investigational obesity treatment.

items.headline_md: **Western Union** scraps its **$500 million** takeover of **Intermex**
items.summary_md: Pushback from California regulators ended the cross-border payments deal.

items.headline_md: NYSE owner ICE and OKX will launch **24/7 tokenized stock trading** on **Nov 23**
items.summary_md: Eligible US customers will be able to trade tokenized versions of 70+ assets.

items.headline_md: Update: **Supercell** and **King** bosses push back on the EU's **Digital Fairness Act**
items.summary_md: The Commission formally proposed it Nov 11; it would switch off paid virtual currencies by default for minors and ban loot boxes and pay-to-win for them, with fines up to 6% of global revenue.

items.headline_md: **Lego Digital Play** buys Manchester mobile studio **ForthStar Games**
items.summary_md: The undisclosed deal expands Lego's presence in mobile gaming.

items.headline_md: More than **1,600** Rockstar UK staff start voting on union recognition
items.summary_md: The ballot runs Nov 12–26, a week before **GTA VI** launches on Nov 19.

items.headline_md: Take-Two says **GTA VI** pre-orders are running far above expectations
items.summary_md: It still posted a rare **$54M** quarterly loss, partly on softer NBA 2K27 sales.

items.headline_md: **PlayStation 5** passes **100 million** units shipped
items.summary_md: Sony updated its official figures, making it the eighth console to reach the milestone.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman's r/decomps Wii U lifter (an unrelated 0-star toolkit, BlackLineInteractive/nWiiURecomp, turned up on GitHub). The r/decomps feed timed out this morning, so Reddit wasn't read directly.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: **NX2navi v0.9.0** (Ocarina of Time PC recomp) is out with a new shader translator
items.summary_md: Posted this morning; existing installs update in the launcher, and shaders re-translate in the background for a few minutes of play.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: NotRexed's **Hookshot 2.1** brings the Ocarina of Time recomp to Windows and Linux
items.summary_md: Playable from Kokiri Forest on, it needs a mesh-shader GPU and still lists crash and shadow bugs; at least six OoT recomps have gone public in a week.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: **Fritchii v5.8.4** emulator boosts Ocarina of Time performance
items.summary_md: It fixes saves landing in the wrong profile and adds per-game DLSS settings, on top of 5.8's stutter and VRAM fixes.

items.headline_md: PS5: **KytyPS5** can now swap Sony's PSSR upscaling for **NVIDIA DLSS**
items.summary_md: It works in PS5 Pro mode on RTX cards, and users supply their own DLSS model.

sections.title: Movies
sections.body_md: Weekend box office for Nov 13–15 lands Sunday; these are forecasts.

items.headline_md: Johnny Depp's **Ebenezer** is forecast to open to **$20M–$25M** this weekend
items.summary_md: It's Depp's first major studio film since 2018, directed by Ti West.

items.headline_md: **Godzilla Minus Zero** is forecast at **$12M–$17M** in its second weekend
items.summary_md: It opened to **$30.6M**, the best debut ever for a foreign-language live-action film domestically.

items.headline_md: Update: **How to Rob a Bank** sits at **44%** on Rotten Tomatoes from 39 reviews
items.summary_md: Wider reviews are cooler than the first reactions; it opens Nov 13, tracking around **$6M–$10M**.

items.headline_md: **Skydance** plans a **$30B+** yearly content spend while layoffs loom
items.summary_md: An HBO Max and Paramount+ bundle comes in early 2027, and Jeremy Latcham replaces Gunn and Safran at DC Studios.

items.headline_md: **TSMC** approves up to **$1 billion** to invest in **Anthropic** and **OpenAI**
items.summary_md: It's a bid to broaden its AI exposure beyond making the chips.

items.headline_md: Google launches the **Gemini Decisions API** for fast yes/no and scoring calls
items.summary_md: It evaluates up to 1,000 questions per request and starts at $0.10 per million input tokens.

items.headline_md: DeepMind unveils **AlphaGenome 2** for cell-level DNA predictions
items.summary_md: It finds nearly twice as many gene-expression variants as before; research use only.

items.headline_md: Amazon releases **AWS Emulator**, a free local simulator of 200+ services
items.summary_md: Amazon says AI agents wrote all of its code with no human code review.

items.headline_md: **United Airlines** moves to block third-party AI agents from booking flights
items.summary_md: It cites risks to personal data, unintended purchases and frequent-flyer miles.

items.headline_md: **Roku** is quitting the smart home business to focus on streaming
items.summary_md: Days after Fox closed its purchase, it's winding down device sales but will keep supporting existing gear.

items.headline_md: Google tests a **View app screenshots** link in mobile app-install search ads
items.summary_md: Users can preview store screenshots before installing; it may be a small test.

items.headline_md: IBM announces its **Nighthawk r3** quantum processor with **520** qubits
items.summary_md: It's built to run 10,000 quantum operations.

items.headline_md: Meta infrastructure chief **Santosh Janardhan** will leave in early 2027
items.summary_md: Former AWS exec Dave Brown becomes head of infrastructure.

items.headline_md: Commerce is reportedly finalizing a rule to block Chinese remote access to US AI chips
items.summary_md: It targets remote data-center access and chip smuggling into China.
Traders see a December Fed hike as a certainty per CME FedWatch; PPI is due Friday.
CoreWeave's results revived the AI trade.

items.headline_md: Movers at 3:26 AM AZ: **Nvidia −6.57%**, **CoreWeave −5.54%**, **Tetra Tech +8.42%** premarket
items.summary_md: Nvidia fell on reports its board may remove Huang; Tetra Tech beat estimates.
Quoted in the early New York session.
Quoted at 1:35 AM AZ.
